description: Company Description https://www.msxi.com/en/ At MSX International , we’ve been partnering with leading automotive companies for over 25 years, helping them enhance their retail strategies and streamline operations. Our expertise in areas like dealer performance, repair optimization, and consumer engagement positions us as a trusted partner in the evolving mobility industry. Job Description The primary purpose of the Data Analyst role is to leverage data-driven insights to enhance the efficiency, quality, and innovation of our products and services. By analyzing proactive and predictive data, the Data Analyst will support the development of predictive models, facilitate early detection of issues, and contribute to faster resolution of complaints. This role is crucial in driving cost savings through proactive monitoring and providing actionable insights to quality and R&D functions, ultimately improving overall customer satisfaction and operational performance. Roles and Responsibilities: Data Analysis: Analyze proactive and predictive data, including DTC, CAN signals, and job card failure analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. Collaboration: Work closely with developers to provide insights for predictive model development and ensure the accuracy and relevance of the models. Quality and R&D Support: Offer inferences to quality and R&D functions for early detection of issues and faster resolution of complaints. Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor ticket Turnaround Time (TAT) and report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to track performance and identify areas for improvement. Cost Savings: Identify opportunities for cost savings through proactive monitoring and analysis. Data Visualization: Create visual representations of data findings through charts, graphs, and dashboards to communicate insights effectively. Reporting: Prepare detailed reports and presentations to communicate insights and findings to stakeholders. Cross-Functional Support: Work with other departments to understand their data needs and support informed decision-making. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field. Advanced certifications in data analytics or related areas are a plus. Additional Information Skills: Strong knowledge of statistical programming languages such as Python or R. Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, or similar. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to interpret complex datasets and provide actionable insights. Strong communication and presentation skills. Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and predictive modeling techniques. Experience with data cleaning, preparation, and exploration. Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL databases Experience: 3 ~ 6 years of relevant experience in automobile Industry is preferred MSX International has been a trusted partner to leading automotive OEMs and mobility companies worldwide, providing strategic support to transform retail operations. With a strong foundation built on Dealer Performance Improvement, Repair Optimization, and Consumer Engagement, we empower businesses by integrating people, processes, and technology to drive measurable success. As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

Experience handling multiple file formats, including CSV, TXT, Excel, JSON, and other structured data sources. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience developing and maintaining Power BI datasets, semantic models, and reporting solutions. Experience using Python for data transformation, automation, and data quality validation. Working knowledge of Azure Data Platform services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Synapse Analytics. Experience supporting financial, operational, sales, or customer analytics reporting environments. Experience creating and maintaining technical documentation, data dictionaries, business rules, and process documentation. Familiarity with Power BI DAX optimization, Power Query transformations, and semantic model performance tuning. title: Voyage Optimization Analyst
description: Job Description Job Description (JD) – Voyage Performance Analyst Position Title Voyage Performance Analyst Location - Chennai (Work from Office) Role Overview We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Voyage Performance Analyst with a strong marine background to support vessel voyage monitoring, performance analysis, and operational optimization. The role involves analyzing vessel performance data, monitoring KPIs, managing voyage efficiency initiatives, and providing fact-based recommendations to improve operational and fuel performance across the fleet. The ideal candidate will have sailing experience as a 2nd Officer or 3rd Officer on commercial vessels and possess a passion for data analytics, vessel optimization, and emerging technologies. Key Responsibilities Voyage Performance Monitoring & Analysis Monitor vessel voyage performance and operational efficiency through daily and monthly performance reviews. Analyze voyage data, fuel consumption trends, weather impacts, speed-performance relationships, and operational KPIs. Provide fact-based recommendations to optimize vessel performance, fuel efficiency, and voyage execution. Support vessel voyage management by identifying performance deviations and recommending corrective actions. Develop and maintain vessel performance reports, dashboards, and analytical insights for internal stakeholders. Reporting & KPI Management Prepare and distribute monthly performance reports and fleet performance summaries. Track and report key operational and performance indicators (KPIs). Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely reporting across vessels and fleets. Support benchmarking activities and monitor fleet performance against predefined targets. Project Management & Operational Support Execute performance improvement and optimization projects efficiently. Participate in new initiatives related to vessel performance, digitalization, and operational excellence. Demonstrate willingness to take ownership of assigned projects and adapt to new challenges. Contribute to daily departmental activities and support service delivery requirements. Stakeholder Management Build and maintain collaborative relationships with internal teams, vessel crews, customers, and external stakeholders. Act as a key point of contact for vessel performance, fuel consumption analysis, and voyage optimization discussions. Support customers and operational teams with data-driven insights and reporting requirements. Technology & Innovation Utilize performance monitoring systems, analytical tools, and reporting platforms to drive operational improvements. Support data capture, validation, modeling, and visualization activities. Stay updated on advancements in maritime digitalization, AI, machine learning, and vessel optimization technologies. Required Qualifications Education & Certifications Bachelor's Degree in Nautical Science, Maritime Studies, Marine Transportation, or related discipline. Valid Second Mate (FG) Certificate of Competency preferred. Experience Minimum 3+ years of sailing experience onboard commercial vessels. Sailing experience as 2nd Officer or 3rd Officer . Recent rank experience as a Navigating Officer onboard. Experience in vessel performance monitoring, voyage management, or marine operations is preferred. Required Skills & Competencies Technical Skills Strong understanding of vessel operations, voyage execution, navigation, and fuel management. Knowledge of vessel performance monitoring and optimization practices. Experience in data collection, validation, reporting, and performance analysis. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and reporting tools. Familiarity with maritime performance systems and voyage optimization platforms is advantageous. Experience with data modeling and performance reporting. Exposure to AI/ML applications in maritime operations is a significant advantage.
